SUBMISSION GUIDELINES

Follow these straightforward steps to submit your manuscript for evaluation

1

Query Form

Fill the query form on our website with your book details.

2

Sample Chapters

Send us the best three chapters / poems / episodes of your book.

3

Synopsis

Send us a detailed and clear synopsis of your book.

4

Author Profile

Send us your personal details with a brief description of your profile.

If we find your script eligible to publish, we will email you within 7 days.
